summary: Mints a short-lived signed URL for a cloud file, for previewing or downloading files uploaded as private.
description: Sign File URL takes a `cloudfile` handle (from Upload File or a record's file property) and, when `sign` fires, asks the backend for a time-limited signed URL to it. A private file's plain `url` 403s for anyone but its owner; the signed URL works for the short window it is valid, which is the intended usage — sign right before rendering, not once and persist. On `success` the signed `url`, its `expiresAt`, and `ttlSeconds` are available; `failure` carries `error`/`errorStatus` the same shape Upload File uses.
whenToUse: Previewing or linking to a file that was uploaded with Upload File's `private` input set. Not needed for public (non-private) files — their plain `cloudFile.url` already works for anyone who can reach the app.

ports.file: The cloudfile to sign; set before firing `sign`.
ports.sign: Signal; requests a fresh signed URL. Re-fire before every use — a previously signed URL expires.
ports.url: The signed URL, valid until `expiresAt`/for `ttlSeconds` seconds from when `sign` fired.
ports.expiresAt: ISO timestamp the signed URL stops working.
ports.ttlSeconds: How long the signed URL is valid for, in seconds, from when it was minted.

patterns: Fire `sign` from the same signal that produced the `cloudFile` (e.g. Upload File's `success`), so the graph never holds a `cloudFile` without also having signed it.
antiPatterns: Persisting a signed `url` (e.g. saving it to a record) instead of the plain cloudfile — the signature expires and the stored link stops working; store the cloudfile, sign again at render time.
